features.feature: Sort songs by column / column browser

features.wire: Still one sort key cycled by the toolbar button (View > Sort Songs By picks one); no column table with header-click sort

features.note: Player sheet and mini bar. Window > MiniPlayer (Option+Cmd+M) opens a small extra window with the artwork, title and artist, the transport, a scrubber and the volume; closing it returns to the main window. Window > Keep MiniPlayer on Top floats it. The layout and hit tests are tested headless in music/miniplayer.rs. Not yet checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget that the window opens, takes taps and drags, floats when asked and closes; confirm the artwork (the BIG cache size) fits its 80 pt box.

features.note: A .lrc file beside a song, or else the lyrics tagged in the file (ID3 USLT), adds a Lyrics switch on the Now Playing sheet; timed lyrics highlight the line being sung and follow the song. View > Show Lyrics does the same. Plain-text lyrics are listed without highlight. Not yet checked on Midget.
features.wire: Verify on Midget the timed .lrc highlighting, lyrics embedded in an MP3 (USLT) and plain-text lyrics in the Now Playing sheet.

features.note: The ten-band model with presets and peaking filters is tested on the host (equalizer.rs). Not wired: the audio service (springboard/audiod) has no gain stage to run it in, and there is no Equalizer panel yet.
features.wire: Equalizer gain stage in the audio service, and an Equalizer panel from the Window menu

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/playback.rs (Playback::gain, crossfade_gains, loudness_from_replaygain); springboard/src/media/id3.rs, ilst.rs (ReplayGain tag readers)
features.note: Crossfade length (up to 12 seconds), the Sound Check gain toward -16 dB with a 9 dB limit, the settings file, the equal-power crossfade curve and the ReplayGain track tag (ID3 TXXX and MP4 freeform) are read and tested headless. Not yet: no Settings page sets them; the audio service plays one track at a time (springboard/src/media/audioplayer.rs has one decoder and one gain, the volume), so there is no second decoder to overlap the next track and no per-track gain stage, and nothing sends the values to the engine.
features.wire: Settings page with the crossfade seconds and a Sound Check switch; a per-track gain stage and a second decoder in audioplayer.rs for the overlap; send the track gain (loudness_from_replaygain) with each queued track.

features.note: Recently Added and Recently Played lists under Songs; Recently Played comes from the play log in stats.txt, and Favourite Songs is listed beside them. Not yet checked on Midget.
